Rooted|1.warmup: Work through the warm-up movements in order, then build to your first work set.
Rooted|1.finisher: 3 min easy walk, stretch the muscles trained for 2 minutes, then 1 minute of 90/90 breathing.
Rooted|1.notes: Rest 2 to 3 minutes between main sets. Stop each main set with 1 to 2 reps in reserve. Exhale through the hardest part of each rep and use a brief brace only on your heaviest sets. Week 4 of every block is a deload. Energy changes across the cycle for some women. See the Cycle Notes tab and adjust effort, not the plan.

Rooted|2.warmup: 3 min easy walking, then begin the first movement at a low effort.
Rooted|2.finisher: 5 min of slow breathing: in for 4 seconds, out for 6 seconds.
Rooted|2.notes: Easy effort only. Finish feeling better than you started.

Rooted|3.finisher: 3 min easy walk, stretch the muscles trained for 2 minutes, then 1 minute of 90/90 breathing.

Sculpted|1.warmup: Work through the warm-up movements in order, then build to your first work set.
Sculpted|1.finisher: 3 min easy walk, stretch the muscles trained for 2 minutes, then 1 minute of 90/90 breathing.
